nina: Following up on the quant RFCCan we define a safe nighttime int4 policy for non-critical routes and an observable rollback hook?
omar: Yes but we need a clear safety envelope. Suggest: (1) opt-in route flag, (2) nightly window, (3) sample-capture and replay bucket, (4) automatic revert thresholds.
kevin: On evaluation I observed median QA drop ~2.2% for some long-tail queries when using int4 on the reranker. We should set a conservative min_quality per-route.
tara: Draft config idea:```
quant_policy:
  default: int8
  windows:
    offpeak: 23:00-05:00
  routes:
    /typeahead:
      allow_lowbit: true
      window: offpeak
      min_quality: 0.94
      fallback_chain: [int4,int8,fp16]
      immutable: false
  cooldown_s: 120
  canary_pct: 1
```
nina: Good. Also add `replay_bucket` (s3 prefix) and `sample_limit` so we can attach examples for postmortem.
omar: For runtime: decision must be atomic and idempotent: consult route policy -> canary allocation -> pool budget -> telemetry guards -> apply. If fallback, emit `quant.fallback` event with reason.
sre-bot: Alert rule suggestion: fire when `quant.deg_score` > 0.05 for 3m OR `quant.fallback_rate` > 0.01 for 10m.
kevin: We'll need an offline evaluator that can run the profile against a held-out adversarial set to estimate worst-case regressions before enabling. I'll own that.
tara: Client hint header sketch: `X-Precision-Hint: prefer=int4;min_quality=0.95` but runtime must ignore for immutable routes.
deploy-bot: Created tickets QP-322 (profile API), QP-323 (canary infra), QP-324 (replay bucket + retention).
nina: Ops playbook: if deg_score > threshold, auto-roll to int8, capture 500 top delta samples, notify #eng-oncall and create runbook incident with steps to escalate to product.
omar: Also add a per-pool `max_lowbit_inflight` to avoid numerically-unstable oversubscription.
kevin: Small implementation note: profile binding should be by model_sha + profile_id. Runtime switch replaces profile_id pointer only. Avoid model redeploys.
tara: Action items: nina update RFC + playbook, kevin build adversarial evaluator, omar prototype atomic decision and pool budget, deploy-bot wire tickets.
nina: Let's default to conservative (no lowbit) and make lowbit an explicit opt-in after QA + canary. :thumbsup:
